description: This file contains a Drupal module hook implementation class 'FileFormHooks' that alters the file system configuration form to add filename sanitization options and handles the form submission to save these settings.

classes.name: FileFormHooks
classes.description: A class implementing hook functions to modify file form settings and handle their submission in Drupal.

methods.name: formSystemFileSystemSettingsAlter
methods.description: Alters the file system settings form to add filename sanitization options.

methods.name: settingsSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission to save filename sanitization settings.
